pull_request.title: Calorimeter: endcap HCAL baseline design option
pull_request.head: codex/hcal-endcap-design
pull_request.body:
## Executive summary

Design both HCAL endcaps using intact DES036 common readout boards/paired carriers. Broad quadrant layers and aperture-adaptive row origins avoid forcing common rectangles into narrow electronic-sector wedges. Whole-layer rotations move joints and carrier seams together.

The proposal preserves the front plane/aperture and exposes the **62.1 mm depth/radial amendment**: back |z|=6,441.2 mm, outer apothem 4,148 mm. It gives 472 carriers per layer/end, 2,446,848 tiles overall, 1,019.273 t partial modeled mass and 201.844 kW nominal local heat. The existing empty FCal reservation is unchanged; forward and service feasibility remain review gates.

## Change

- Add [DES038](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/c1d091299e3ed358e47ac1fabbfe2b1207160580/docs/design/DES-038-hcal-endcap-common-module.md), parameterized whole-face layouts, exact polygon/aperture checks, shared material/service budgets, physical core-plane masks and face/inner-repair/R–Z drawings.
- Use unchanged hardware, 20 mm row/column/quarter-joint reservations and a 0°/22.5°/45°/67.5° layer cycle. Rotate steel quarter joints and reservations too. Negative ends use proper Rx(pi), including origins, ports and IDs.
- Separate uniform, aligned-adaptive, staggered-adaptive and angular-boundary-filtered controls. Adaptive rows reduce first-core radius **418.10→328.60 mm**; full-face core area remains **55.03%**.
- Count reference-absorber-free common hardware and shared steel/annular frames/covers once. Retain current stress/DAQ overload and explicitly unconnected collector handoffs.

Executed evidence at `7c7f0ba96b69dd754d6e25bd97cef4cfe502bcae`: **19 regional controls** pass. Independent PhysVal reran them and checked **3,105 global centre/edge probes with zero discrepancies**; SysArch assessed interfaces. [Validation and limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/c1d091299e3ed358e47ac1fabbfe2b1207160580/docs/validation/DES-038/results.md).

These are local-z=2 mm core-plane samples, not full native/finite-solid transport, optical/shower response or containment. Endcap steel-ray screening is explicitly NOT_RUN. At eta3.5, 33.33% of sampled phi still has zero planes; eta3.8/4/5 has zero throughout. Negative-y connector-facing strips, inner-frame ports, connected collection, regional power/DAQ, radiation/EOL and thermal/structural feasibility remain open.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Updated scientific tracking, design/evidence links and curated session records.
- [x] Ran regional controls, 44 unchanged common-module controls and 14 historical calorimeter regressions; source/config/output/figure/link audits and project/session/token validators pass.
- [x] Preserved human approval boundaries and exact independent review snapshots. Designs remain DRAFT/PROTOTYPE.
- [x] Added the regional proposal to the current candidate page and provided a separate R–Z overlay. Selected LAYOUT001 geometry/inputs remain unchanged pending review; its existing SVG still reproduces exactly.

This PR targets `main`. Its ancestry retains the campaign dependencies through ordinary merges; merge after #116, #115 and #81. The queue places #84 before #85 so each reviewed diff shrinks as its dependencies reach main. No production integration or engineering acceptance is proposed here.

Companion regional design: **[PR #84](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/84)**.


## Calorimeter baseline campaign — 2026-11-04

Ordinary integration merges preserve current main, original source histories and canonical accounting. The common module is shared; regional configurations remain Si–W baseline design options. LAr regional reparameterization and replay, native full HCAL assemblies, connected services and response/engineering qualification remain follow-ups.

ECAL replacement: [PR115](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/115). Provenance/accounting: [PR116](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/116). Stable tasks: `TASK-B-HCAL-ENDCAP-DESIGN`.

Endcap-specific owner 7,896,204 observed tokens. The shared regional root/reviews are in the barrel owner 26,858,576 and are referenced, never split or duplicated. Shared campaign accounts are references, not per-PR cost allocations. Current coordinator root usage remains active and excluded. Exact ownership, observed input/output counters, visible interactions and limitations are retained in canonical journals/individual ledgers.

Merge queue: #116 → #115 → #81 → #84 → #85. Open campaign PRs target main, so after each dependency lands the next diff shrinks against main; do not merge into an already-merged parent branch. No design lifecycle is advanced or engineering approval inferred.

## Executive summary

Design both HCAL endcaps using intact DES036 common readout boards/paired carriers. Broad quadrant layers and aperture-adaptive row origins avoid forcing common rectangles into narrow electronic-sector wedges. Whole-layer rotations move joints and carrier seams together.

The proposal preserves the front plane/aperture and exposes the **62.1 mm depth/radial amendment**: back |z|=6,441.2 mm, outer apothem 4,148 mm. It gives 472 carriers per layer/end, 2,446,848 tiles overall, 1,019.273 t partial modeled mass and 201.844 kW nominal local heat. The existing empty FCal reservation is unchanged; forward and service feasibility remain review gates.

## Change

- Add [DES038](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/c1d091299e3ed358e47ac1fabbfe2b1207160580/docs/design/DES-038-hcal-endcap-common-module.md), parameterized whole-face layouts, exact polygon/aperture checks, shared material/service budgets, physical core-plane masks and face/inner-repair/R–Z drawings.
- Use unchanged hardware, 20 mm row/column/quarter-joint reservations and a 0°/22.5°/45°/67.5° layer cycle. Rotate steel quarter joints and reservations too. Negative ends use proper Rx(pi), including origins, ports and IDs.
- Separate uniform, aligned-adaptive, staggered-adaptive and angular-boundary-filtered controls. Adaptive rows reduce first-core radius **418.10→328.60 mm**; full-face core area remains **55.03%**.
- Count reference-absorber-free common hardware and shared steel/annular frames/covers once. Retain current stress/DAQ overload and explicitly unconnected collector handoffs.

Executed evidence at `7c7f0ba96b69dd754d6e25bd97cef4cfe502bcae`: **19 regional controls** pass. Independent PhysVal reran them and checked **3,105 global centre/edge probes with zero discrepancies**; SysArch assessed interfaces. [Validation and limitations](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/c1d091299e3ed358e47ac1fabbfe2b1207160580/docs/validation/DES-038/results.md).

These are local-z=2 mm core-plane samples, not full native/finite-solid transport, optical/shower response or containment. Endcap steel-ray screening is explicitly NOT_RUN. At eta3.5, 33.33% of sampled phi still has zero planes; eta3.8/4/5 has zero throughout. Negative-y connector-facing strips, inner-frame ports, connected collection, regional power/DAQ, radiation/EOL and thermal/structural feasibility remain open.

## Dashboard and validation

- [x] Updated scientific tracking, design/evidence links and curated session records.
- [x] Ran regional controls, 44 unchanged common-module controls and 14 historical calorimeter regressions; source/config/output/figure/link audits and project/session/token validators pass.
- [x] Preserved human approval boundaries and exact independent review snapshots. Designs remain DRAFT/PROTOTYPE.
- [x] Added the regional proposal to the current candidate page and provided a separate R–Z overlay. Selected LAYOUT001 geometry/inputs remain unchanged pending review; its existing SVG still reproduces exactly.

This PR targets `main`. Its ancestry retains the campaign dependencies through ordinary merges; merge after #116, #115 and #81. The queue places #84 before #85 so each reviewed diff shrinks as its dependencies reach main. No production integration or engineering acceptance is proposed here.

Companion regional design: **[PR #84](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/84)**.

**Recommendation — proposed NODD DESIGN CHOICE:** start the endcap with full-face Cartesian packing grouped into four mechanical quadrants, using the **unchanged DES036 380 × 240 × 12 mm paired carrier and 184 mm common boards**. Keep a uniform-grid control and explicitly evaluate an aperture-adaptive inner-row arrangement. Avoid making sixteen narrow wedges the module-packing boundaries.

### Depth and boundary contract

**FACT — pinned DES034/LAYOUT001:** front |z| = **4,883.2 mm**, back |z| = **6,379.1 mm**, inner apothem **300 mm**, outer apothem **4,085.9 mm**. DES036 has a **12 mm carrier**.

**INFERENCE:** even zero installation gap gives `36 × (30 + 12) = 1,512 mm`, exceeding the old **1,495.9 mm** complete depth before a back cover. Do not compress the carrier or silently remove steel/layers.

Following the coordinator’s subsequent explicit amendment proposal:

- Preserve **36 layers**, **30 mm sector-owned steel**, **12 mm carrier**, **1 mm installation gap**.
- Use **43 mm repeat pitch** and **10 mm back cover**.
- Total depth: **1,558 mm**; revised back **|z| = 6,441.2 mm**.
- Revised outer endcap apothem **4,148 mm**, following the companion barrel proposal.
- Retain front **4,883.2 mm** and inner apothem **300 mm**.
- Retain the FCal reservation **R = 80–290 mm, |z| = 4,533.2–6,379.1 mm** unchanged.

These are proposed envelope amendments, not facts about the pinned outline. The FCal reservation ends before the revised HCAL rear; this does not authorize extending it or establish a forward shower-depth handover.

An explicit layer convention is:

`steel [z_l,z_l+30] → carrier [z_l+30,z_l+42] → installation gap [z_l+42,z_l+43]`

with `z_l = 4883.2 + 43l`, `l = 0…35`. DES036 scintillator cores occupy carrier-local z = **0.5–3.5 mm**.

**FACT — DES036/config:** one carrier owns 72 tiles, with board centres **(−93,−12), (+93,−12) mm**. Tile centres within each board are spaced by 30 mm; cores are 29.7 mm square.

**INFERENCE:** intrinsic projected core area is

`72 × 29.7² / (380 × 240) = 69.6387%`.

Thus unchanged paired carriers cannot deliver 90% face coverage, even with perfect footprint packing. This is a projected active-face fraction, not detection efficiency.

I ran an independent, dependency-free analytic screen using:

- Revised outer apothem **4,148 mm**;
- **20 mm outer rim** reservation;
- **10 mm inner-aperture clearance**, implemented by an excluded 16-gon of apothem 310 mm;
- Exact outer-polygon corner containment;
- Rectangle–inner-polygon separating-axis rejection;
- No clipped carrier, board or tile.

The denominator is the complete original-aperture annular face, **54.4730 m²**, including the rim reservation.

| Illustrative layout | Carriers/layer | Projected core fraction |
|---|---:|---:|
| Quadrants; 1 mm row gaps; 20 mm full quadrant seams | 524 | 61.09% |
| **Quadrants; 20 mm row collector strips; 20 mm full quadrant seams** | **484** | **56.43%** |
| Simple 16-wedge rows, 380 mm carrier dimension tangent | 336 | 39.17% |
| Simple 16-wedge rows, rotated 240 mm dimension tangent | 432 | 50.37% |

For the proposed quadrant control, carrier centres are

`x = ±(200 + 381i) mm`, `y = ±(130 + 260j) mm`, `i,j ≥ 0`,

followed by the polygon/aperture acceptance tests. This gives 20 mm full seams on the axes, 1 mm between columns and 20 mm between rows. Each quadrant has 121 accepted carriers.

For a narrow wedge with half-angle α = π/16, tangent width W and edge allowance e, the necessary inner-edge condition is

`r_inner ≥ (W/2 + e) / tan(α)`.

With e = 21 mm, it gives **1,060.77 mm** for W = 380 mm and **708.85 mm** for W = 240 mm. Even the unchanged **184 mm board** cannot fit at the 300 mm aperture inside such a narrow wedge: the unallocated wedge width there is only **119.35 mm**.

The uniform quadrant control has first projected tile core at approximately **r = 399.14 mm**. This is a consequence of the chosen row origins, **not an unavoidable minimum of the unchanged carrier**.

For example, an unchanged carrier centred at **(0,430) mm** is tangent to the expanded 310 mm aperture and reaches approximately **r = 328.17 mm** active radius, but crosses the quadrant seam. A carrier at **(200,430) mm** remains within the positive quadrant and reaches approximately **328.60 mm**. It conflicts with the uniform following row at y = 650 mm, so its column’s subsequent row origins must change.

**Proposed priority:** compare aperture-adaptive row origins using the same carrier before commissioning custom boards or tiles. Keep all board/carrier envelopes intact, check neighbours globally, and retain the uniform control. If the resulting staircase boundary still fails the required directional sampling, propose a distinct inner carrier using unchanged common boards; do not call that carrier redesign “module standardization.”

I also evaluated the actual individual tile-core mask at **720 uniformly spaced φ samples**, using the 36 active-plane midpoints. For the quadrant control:

| |η| | Aligned planes: minimum/mean/maximum active planes | Four-layer 0°,22.5°,45°,67.5° pattern |

| 2.0 | 0 / 23.383 / 35 | 13 / 23.383 / 30 |

| 3.4 | 0 / 1.194 / 11 | 0 / 1.194 / 5 |

At |η| = 3.2 and 3.4, the staggered example still gives zero active planes for approximately **26.4%** and **53.1%** of sampled φ, respectively. Therefore it cannot support a blanket acceptance claim.

The coordinator’s proposed **1,558 mm depth amendment**, full-face/quadrant endcap packing and 33-row staggered barrel are coherent prototype directions. They need the following common contracts in both PRs.

### Depth and common envelope

DES036 fixes the carrier at **380×240×12 mm**. Retaining 36 layers, 30 mm steel, 1 mm installation and a 10 mm back cover requires:

\[
36(30+12+1)+10=1558\ \mathrm{mm}.
\]

This exceeds DES034’s 1,495.9 mm allocation by **62.1 mm**. Even zero installation gaps require 1,522 mm. Source: `tools/hcal_readout/config.json`, `carrier.size_mm/absorber_mm`; `DES-036`, “Shared carrier”; `DES-034`, “External backbone and HCAL interfaces”.

Recommend the **explicit proposed outline amendment**:

- Barrel: front apothem **2,600 mm**, outer apothem **4,158 mm**, half-length **4,483.2 mm**.
- Endcaps: front **|z|=4,883.2 mm**, back **6,441.2 mm**, inner/outer apothems **300/4,148 mm**.
- Preserve ECAL’s circular **R=2,300–2,600 mm** annulus and **400 mm** rear egress break.
- Leave the existing empty FCal reservation unchanged, as instructed.

These are proposed changes, not already approved detector dimensions. Retain DES034 as the comparison.

Reducing layer count or installation clearance is a separate physical alternative:

| Layers / installation | Depth including 10 mm cover | Difference from old allocation |
|---|---:|---:|
| 36 / 1 mm | 1,558 mm | +62.1 mm |
| 36 / 0.5 mm | 1,540 mm | +44.1 mm |
| 35 / 1 mm | 1,515 mm | +19.1 mm |
| 35 / 0.5 mm | 1,497.5 mm | +1.6 mm |
| 34 / 1 mm | 1,472 mm | −23.9 mm |

The amendment preserves the sampling comparison and unchanged module. It leaves **no additional radial/axial depth budget beyond the named 10 mm cover**. Frames and collectors therefore require explicit lateral/axial allocations or further amendments.

The amended barrel corner is **4,239.460 mm**, rather than 4,158 mm. DES034’s R=4,300 mm egress, less its 25 mm water-jacket radius and 20 mm clearance, leaves only **15.540 mm extra clearance**. This passes that particular analytic inequality; it demonstrates no additional HCAL service capacity.

### Barrel organization and phase constraints

Use common carrier local axes:

\[
(x,y,z)=(e_\phi,e_z,e_r).
\]

Thus tubes run axially and the shared connector bay points toward local +y.

With **33 rows**, 240 mm carrier length and proposed **20 mm inter-row collector strips**, occupied length is:

\[
33(240)+32(20)=8560\ \mathrm{mm}.
\]

Keeping 20 mm end flanges inside the half-length gives usable bounds ±4,463.2 mm. A centred row pattern ends at ±4,280 mm; therefore each layer’s axial phase must satisfy:

\[
|s_\ell|\le183.2\ \mathrm{mm}.
\]

The proposed **−60, 0, +60 mm** phases leave at least **123.2 mm** between carrier extrema and flange inner faces.

DES036’s active core field spans local y **−101.85 to +77.85 mm**. At 260 mm row pitch, aligned rows produce **80.3 mm macro gaps** between core fields. The gap intervals for the three proposed phases have no common intersection, giving a useful geometric reason for staggering. Physical tile gaps, tangential seams and edge losses still require complete core checks.

With 33 rows, phase zero places a carrier across the midplane. An “aligned midplane-zero” control therefore needs a different phase: **+130 mm** is admissible, leaves **53.2 mm** minimum flange clearance, and places the nominal core gap at **z=−52.15 to +28.15 mm**. Report its asymmetric end reserves. An aligned phase-zero control remains useful for correlated cracks away from the midplane.

For tangential packing, evaluate the full rectangular carrier against the **narrowest radial face**, rather than the layer midpoint or outer face:

\[
|x_c|+\frac{380}{2}
\le r_{\rm carrier,front}\tan(\pi/16)-\text{named edge allowance}.
\]

Check all carrier corners and every layer. Keep the proposed 1 mm tangential gap, sector edge rails and any staggering offsets explicit.

### Endcap organization and frames

Full-face Cartesian packing within mechanical quadrants avoids the earlier artificial 16-wedge packing hole. Keep **mechanical quadrants independent of 16 readout-sector IDs**, with deterministic ID assignment documented for carriers spanning a readout boundary.

The failure being avoided is substantial:
